name: Can Androids Pray
source:
CAN ANDROIDS PRAY is a sitcom-length choice-based narrative experience about two angry femme mech pilots at the end of the world, and God.

[Edited from [url=https://aprioridigital.com/games/can-androids-pray-blue]aPriori Digital[/url]]
translation:
《机器人能祈祷吗》是一部情景喜剧长度的基于选择的叙事体验，讲述了世界末日的两个愤怒的女性机甲飞行员和上帝的故事。

[编辑自[url=https://aprioridigital.com/games/can-androids-pray-blue]aPriori Digital[/url]]
